subject: Application for the B2B Product Designer role
body: Hello, I am applying for the B2B Product Designer role. Over three years in product design, I have built Figma design systems, conducted qualitative user interviews, and worked closely with product and engineering partners. These experiences align with your need for a designer who can support a consistent system while staying connected to user evidence and delivery constraints. Experimentation experience is listed as preferred but is not verified in the supplied profile, so I would discuss that area transparently. I would welcome the opportunity to show relevant design-system and research examples.

claims.text: The candidate has three years of product design experience.
The candidate has worked with Figma design systems, user interviews, product, and engineering.

caveats: Experimentation experience is not verified in the supplied facts.
